sysname MJC-OHXNAT-AFWOJX-K9640
#
dhcp snooping enable ipv4
#
ip vpn-instance _management_vpn_
 ipv4-family
#
vlan 100
 dhcp snooping enable
 name P2P-To-NSF
#
vlan 213
 dhcp snooping enable
 name MGMT
#
vlan 214
 dhcp snooping enable
 name VOIP
#
vlan 710
 dhcp snooping enable
 name OT-HRGA
#
acl name VOIP-GA-BCQ advance
 rule 5 permit ip source 10.255.0.1 0.0.0.255 destination 10.255.0.2 0.0.0.255
 rule 10 permit ip source 10.255.0.1 0.0.0.255 destination 10.255.0.3 0.0.0.255
 rule 15 permit ip source 10.255.0.1 0.0.0.255 destination 10.255.0.4 0
 rule 20 permit ip source 10.255.0.1 0.0.0.255 destination 10.255.0.5 0
 rule 25 permit ip source 10.255.0.1 0.0.0.255 destination 10.255.0.6 0
 rule 30 permit icmp source 10.255.0.7 10.255.0.8
 rule 35 permit icmp source 10.255.0.9 10.255.0.8
 rule 40 permit icmp source 10.255.0.10 0.0.0.255 destination 10.255.0.11 0.0.0.255
 rule 45 permit icmp source 10.255.0.10 0.0.0.255 destination 10.255.0.12 0.0.0.255
 rule 50 permit ip source 10.255.0.10 0.0.0.255 destination 10.255.0.11 0.0.0.255
 rule 55 permit ip source 10.255.0.10 0.0.0.255 destination 10.255.0.12 0.0.0.255
 rule 60 permit ip source 10.255.0.1 0.0.0.255 destination 10.255.0.13 0
 rule 65 permit ip source 10.255.0.1 0.0.0.255 destination 10.255.0.14 0
 rule 70 permit ip source 10.255.0.1 0.0.0.255 destination 10.255.0.15 0
 rule 75 permit ip source 10.255.0.1 0.0.0.255 destination 10.255.0.16 0
 rule 80 permit ip source 10.255.0.1 0.0.0.255 destination 10.255.0.17 0
 rule 85 permit ip source 10.255.0.1 0.0.0.255 destination 10.255.0.18 0
 rule 90 permit ip source 10.255.0.1 0.0.0.255 destination 10.255.0.19 0
 rule 95 permit ip source 10.255.0.1 0.0.0.255 destination 10.255.0.20 0
 rule 100 permit ip source 10.255.0.1 0.0.0.255 destination 10.255.0.21 0
 rule 105 permit ip source 10.255.0.1 0.0.0.255 destination 10.255.0.22 0
 rule 110 permit ip source 10.255.0.1 0.0.0.255 destination 10.255.0.23 0
 rule 115 permit ip source 10.255.0.1 0.0.0.255 destination 10.255.0.24 0
 rule 120 permit ip source 10.255.0.1 0.0.0.255 destination 10.255.0.25 0
#
traffic classifier VOIP-GA-BCQ type and
 if-match acl VOIP-GA-BCQ
#
traffic behavior VOIP-GA-BCQ
#
traffic policy VOIP-GA-BCQ
 classifier VOIP-GA-BCQ behavior VOIP-GA-BCQ precedence 5
#
interface Vlanif100
 description P2P-To-NSF
 ip address 10.255.0.26 255.255.255.252
#
interface Vlanif213
 description MGMT
 ip address 10.255.0.27 255.255.255.0
 dhcp select global
#
interface Vlanif214
 description VOIP
 ip address 10.255.0.28 255.255.255.0
 traffic-policy VOIP-GA-BCQ inbound
 dhcp select global
#
interface Vlanif710
 description OT-HRGA
 ip address 10.255.0.29 255.255.255.0
#
ip route-static 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 10.255.0.30 preference 5 description SANGFOR-NSF
#
ip route-static 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 10.255.0.31 preference 10 description TO-BCQ-ROU-BACKUP
#
user-interface vty 0 4
 authentication-mode aaa
 idle-timeout 15 0
 protocol inbound ssh
#
ip route-static 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 10.255.0.30 preference 5 description SANGFOR-NSF
#
ip route-static 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 10.255.0.31 preference 10 description TO-BCQ-ROU-BACKUP
